messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert — p99 latency (eu-west-1) crossed threshold (3.0s). SLO burn detected. Pager: @oncall-alex. Auto-escalation in 5m if unacked.
oncall-alex: acked. I'm on it. :eyes:
eng-ops-jamie: seeing a traffic spike around 02:07-02:12 UTC. Autoscaler didn't add pods fast enough; there was also an autopager suppression window 02:05-02:15 that dropped noisy alerts. possible suppression gap causing delayed escalation.
sre-lee: KV cache miss ratio up ~6x, eviction rate spiked. tail latencies match. digging into sidecar queue lengths now.
oncall-alex: running runbook: tail-latency -> check autoscaler / queue / kvcache. @eng-ops-jamie can you paste the queue stats? I'll start a temporary reroute to dedicated pool if needed.
eng-ops-jamie: queue snapshot:
```
sidecar_queue_len: 128 -> 512 (peak)
kvcache_evictions_per_min: 420
pod_ready_replicas: 6 (desired 10)
autoscaler_events: scale_up_attempt at 02:08 failed (OOM on init)
```
eng-ops-jamie: trying a manual scale to 12 replicas, and warming a dedicated pool node in eu-west.
sre-lee: confirmed some worker pods hit GPU OOM during warmup, causing scale failures. I'll patch the init image to use lower mem setting and restart deployment.
pm-kate: customer impact? any 5xxs or feature degradation?
oncall-alex: no notable 5xx spike in the last 20m, but p95->p99 elevated. A small subset of realtime clients seeing >3s TTFB. Not yet customer-facing error rate issue, but visible quality degradation.
eng-ops-jamie: scaled to 12, warmup started, reroute to dedicated warm pool enabled. Observability: p99 down from 3.8s -> 2.6s after reroute (partial).
oncall-alex: good. keep monitoring. I'll stay pinned until metrics stable. If p99 stays >3s after 10m we open a bridge and escalate PD.
sre-lee: rolling restart on problematic init image happening now.
pm-kate: please add a short bulletin if we hit customer-visible errors. Thanks.
oncall-alex: ack. Will update in 5m with metrics. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Note: PagerDuty auto-escalation canceled (alert acknowledged).
